The '''Cassander sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], it was annexed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which divided it into three subsectors, known collectively as the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran sectors]]. These subsectors were the [[Cassander subsector|Cassander]], [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin]] and [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan subsector]]s. Throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sector was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] of the Clone Wars, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Traavis]] led a campaign in these sectors.

Prior to Imperial rule, the sectors were a loosely governed domain called the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]], which contained over 100 [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].
